opening.argument: The title identifies coverage of PM Modi and President Trump's roadshow to Sabarmati Ashram in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, while the sampled visuals show a black vehicle passing crowds behind barriers with US and Indian flags and performers on a stage marked TRUMP. Those are observable features of public-event news and entertainment coverage, not an investment offer, payment requirement, credential request, or other deceptive mechanism. The description's request to subscribe to the Prime Minister Office's official YouTube channel is ordinary channel engagement, not a linked financial or credential solicitation.
